title: Design: the price details popover for a tier price
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with one range from $0.00: Default Markup % 50, tier A Markup % 20.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test, part A, in category A, cost $10.00, in a bin (for example E-11).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with part A added.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Point at part A's sell price on the Lines tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab; part A's price shows with no icon beside it.

Step 2:

  • A white popover with a shadow opens just below the price, titled "Why this price".
  • Its rows show a gray label at the left and the value at the right: Priced by, Matrix, Cost Range, Rule, Cost, Sell price, Priced on and From, in that order, as in picture 12.1.
  • A last line in gray reads customer A's name, "'s work order tier (" tier A's name ") prices its parts."
